abstract: The Heterogeneous AutoRegressive model for the logs of Realised Volatility (HARL) has established itself as the benchmark specification for modelling and forecasting return volatility, owing to its parsimony and ability to capture the strong persistence typically observed in RV. To address potential concerns such as measurement errors, nonlinearities, and non-spherical residuals, numerous variants of the baseline HARL model have been developed in the literature. This paper contributes to this body of work by proposing a new class of dynamic state-space models with time-varying parameters. The parameter dynamics are assumed to follow an autoregressive process, with or without stochastic volatility, giving rise to two specifications: SHARP and SHARP-SV. Both models are designed to capture the evolving nature of return volatility and are estimated via Bayesian inference using Particle Gibbs sampling. Empirical applications to high-frequency data on SPY, sector ETFs, representative NYSE stocks, and the VIX index demonstrate that our proposed models on average outperform alternative HARL-based specifications in forecasting volatility, particularly at medium- and long-term horizons. An extensive Monte Carlo analysis further illustrates the advantages of our approach in terms of both estimation accuracy and predictive performance.
abstract_zh: 基于已实现波动率（RV）对数的异质自回归模型（HARL）因其简洁性及捕捉RV中通常观察到的强持续性的能力，已成为建模和预测收益波动率的基准规范。为解决测量误差、非线性及非球形残差等潜在问题，文献中已发展出多种基线HARL模型的变体。本文通过提出一类具有时变参数的新动态状态空间模型，为该领域研究做出贡献。参数动态被假定遵循自回归过程，可包含或不包含随机波动性，由此产生两种规格：SHARP和SHARP-SV。两种模型均旨在捕捉收益波动率的演变特性，并通过使用粒子吉布斯抽样的贝叶斯推断进行估计。对SPY、行业ETF、代表性纽交所股票及VIX指数的高频数据实证应用表明，我们提出的模型在预测波动率方面平均优于其他基于HARL的规格，尤其是在中期和长期预测区间。广泛的蒙特卡洛分析进一步展示了我们方法在估计精度和预测性能方面的优势。
title: A dynamic state-space HAR model
